title: Too early First Look: Hexatrix Demo by BLiP Games on itch.io
author: BLiPGames

comments.author: shuwatto
comments.body:
A full stack dev here.

Do you have any advice to conjure 31-page-gdd up?

BTW, the game looks really nice.

replies.author: BLiPGames
replies.body: The conjuration was a couple hours of back and forth with ChatGPT. I spent time describing what I wanted from a technical perspective. I took what it produced, proof-read, and edited it. I kept the ChatGPT thread focused on broad design and then breaking it down into known coding patterns and systems. The most important thing I did was tell it that I was developing it as 3 layers to keep separate. I made sure to keep Presentation, Data, and Domain as separate because I've noticed not doing that ends up with a ton of spaghetti.
